title: Pentagon says Trump approves Army firing squad execution of Fort Hood killer Nidal Hasan
summary_full: Former Army Maj. Nidal Hassan was sentenced to death after a court-martial that convicted him of killing 13 and wounding 32 others at an Army base in Texas.
